V20 rev12 - the hinged strips, one per side, each carrying both posts · pin at the front · fingerscrews come up through the BOTTOM - purple knobs underneath at the back (flip it over to see them) · the canal runs through front to rear for the cables - 40.5 wide at the front, 30 at the rear, steep straight walls · the centre top at the FRONT is taken down to the canal floor height, so the boss on the dish clears it when attaching · strips shown DOWN: posts flush, dish slides on and off · drag to spin · pinch to zoom · double-tap resets
SIZE KEY (mm) - tap to open
Bracket V20165.2 wide - widths are the fixed version Steven made, measured by Ashley and Steven against the dish itself - they stand - the RAILS are his crest ridges running along both sloped edges - the top falls away outside the crest down his wedge side, so the crest stands proud to bear on the pocket rim, and the middle of the top sits back down at his surface between the channels - the rest of the top stays raised to the side walls height - canal down the middle running through front to rear so the cables have a place to go through, 40.5 wide at the front tapering to 30 at the rear with steep straight walls - the centre strip at the front is taken back down to the canal floor height (the dish boss runs there when attaching), ramping back up behind the front posts - a channel in the top on each side for its strip - the screw housings underneath at the back add a small bump, 3 past the old outline
Strips (green)one per side, 36 wide x 56 long, sits in the channel - carries both posts - hinged at the front on the orange pin
Posts (blue)front and rear post on each strip - flush with the top while the strip is down; they rise into the dish when the strip is jacked up
Hinge pins (orange)one across the front of each strip - the strip rocks on it - shortened to end at the canal wall so nothing pokes into the cable run
Fingerscrews (purple)UNDER the back of the bracket - the knob hangs below, the screw comes up through the bottom and its tip bears on the underside of the strip - screw up to jack the strip up and clamp the dish; back it off and the strip drops so the dish slides free
Scale bar (gray)50.0 long x 10.0 tall mm
